title: Group image drawing method and device based on federal learning
assignee: China Telecom Cloud Technology Co Ltd

pse.problem: Inflexible position calculation complexity and accuracy adjustment, incomplete authorization link in traditional federal learning-based group portrait methods
pse.solution_function: Federal learning-based guest group portrait method performs data analysis, encoding, encryption sample alignment, and joint modeling to achieve accurate user image complementation through cooperative modeling in a federal learning mode.
pse.solution_structure: The solution involves DPI log data, user ID, mapping relation, POI position information, geohash coding, and federal learning model.
pse.solution_implementation: DPI log data is obtained and analyzed to get ur1, mdn, and userID. A mapping relation between userID and mdn is established. POI position information is geohash coded and the coding bits are adjusted according to precision requirement. Encryption sample alignment is carried out on the sample set, followed by joint modeling in a federal learning mode.
pse.effect: The solution provides flexible position calculation, accuracy adjustment, and complete authorization link, enabling efficient and secure group portrait generation.
